blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Mapua leaned on Cyrus Cuenco to outlast Emilio Aguinaldo College, 89-84, in overtime in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament on Tuesday night at San Juan Arena. Cuenco turned in 28 points that went with four rebounds and four assists to push the Cardinals to their third straight win for a 3-3 record. “Our captain stepping up in overtime is such a big thing for us,” coach Chito Victolero said.
